1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically directed to bankruptcy proceedings;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records in compliance with bankruptcy court rules and procedures, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations having different procedural requirements; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations through a centralized bankruptcy filing service.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further comprises transforming the data records into court-specific formats required by each bankruptcy court.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record specifically formatted for generating a proof of claim document in compliance with bankruptcy law;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records in accordance with applicable bankruptcy court rules, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include court-specific formatting; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations through a centralized bankruptcy filing system.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further comprises adapting each proof of claim to comply with the specific procedural requirements of each bankruptcy court.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages specifically notify the creditors of bankruptcy case filings and provide case-specific information related to the creditors' claims.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol with encryption and authentication specific to bankruptcy filing operations.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site that is specifically configured for bankruptcy claim filing by creditors.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day with bankruptcy courts.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to bankruptcy claim filings; and
sending the report to a particular creditor regarding the status of their bankruptcy claims.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site.

14. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record for compliance with applicable bankruptcy court requirements.
